title: Governor (primary frequency response)
description: Speed governor: the lumped centre-of-inertia response of the frequency model and the per-machine TGOV1, IEEEG1, hydro and GAST governor models (whose required parameters have no code default). Frequency: Mark-gated. markGated (N312, October 2026): false on every parameter a gridsim-dynamics/2 file feeds into the RMS study (F23, wired); model and droopPu stay true because they also set the Mark-gated lumped frequency model, as do the lumped-only governorTimeConstantS and responsiveFraction.

model.description: Governor model: the lumped centre-of-inertia primary response, or a per-machine TGOV1, IEEEG1, hydro or GAST (simple gas turbine with exhaust temperature load limit) governor. HYGOV names GridSim's simplified hydro governor (N312): the transient-droop governor (permanent droop droopPu, transient droop, dashpot reset, gate servo) driving an ideal, lossless water column, which is the PSS/E HYGOV structure WITHOUT the turbine gain At, the no-load flow qNL, the turbine damping Dturb and the gate velocity limit. Those four have no key here, so a full PSS/E HYGOV data set is represented only approximately.

droopPu.description: Governor droop R (pu speed per pu power). TWO DIFFERENT code values (inconsistency register).

governorTimeConstantS.description: Primary-response lag of the lumped governor (s). Literature-typical, unfitted.

responsiveFraction.description: Share of generation that responds (headroom) in the lumped model. Literature-typical, unfitted.

turbineDampingPu.description: TGOV1 turbine damping Dt, GAST DTURB (pu). Absent: 0 for both.

valveMinPu.description: Valve / gate lower limit (pu on the machine base). Absent: 0 (also for GAST VMIN).

valveMaxPu.description: Valve / gate upper limit (pu on the machine base): TGOV1 VMAX, IEEEG1 PMAX, hydro gate maximum, GAST VMAX. Absent: unlimited (GAST included). Read by a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

tgov1ValveTimeS.description: TGOV1 valve / steam-bowl lag T1 (s). Required for model TGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

tgov1ReheatLeadS.description: TGOV1 reheat lead T2 (s). Required for model TGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

tgov1ReheatLagS.description: TGOV1 reheat lag T3 (s, above 0). Required for model TGOV1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1LagS.description: IEEEG1 governor lag T1 (s); 0 together with a zero lead is the pure droop gain. Required for model IEEEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1LeadS.description: IEEEG1 governor lead T2 (s). Required for model IEEEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1ValveTimeS.description: IEEEG1 valve servo time constant T3 (s). Required for model IEEEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1ChestS.description: IEEEG1 steam-chest time constant T4 (s). Required for model IEEEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1ReheatS.description: IEEEG1 reheater time constant T5 (s). Required for model IEEEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1CrossoverS.description: IEEEG1 crossover time constant T6 (s). Required for model IEEEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1LpS.description: IEEEG1 second crossover / LP time constant T7 (s). Required for model IEEEG1 in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

ieeeg1K2.description: IEEEG1 LP-shaft fraction K2 (R083). The eight fractions K1..K8 are fractions of the total turbine power and must sum to 1.

ieeeg1UoPuPerS.description: IEEEG1 maximum valve opening rate Uo (R083), in pu of the machine base per second (MW/s per MW of rating); above 0. Absent: unlimited.

ieeeg1UcPuPerS.description: IEEEG1 maximum valve closing rate Uc (R083), in pu of the machine base per second, below 0. Absent: unlimited.

hygovTransientDroopPu.description: Hydro governor transient droop Rt (the permanent droop Rp is droopPu). Required for model HYGOV in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

hygovResetTimeS.description: Hydro governor dashpot reset time Tr (s, above 0). Required for model HYGOV in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

hygovGateTimeS.description: Hydro governor gate servo time constant Tg (s). Required for model HYGOV in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

hygovWaterTimeS.description: Hydro water starting time Tw (s, above 0; ideal water column). Required for model HYGOV in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file (F23).

gastValveTimeS.description: GAST governor mechanism (fuel valve) time constant T1 (s). Required for model GAST in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

gastTurbineTimeS.description: GAST turbine power time constant T2 (s). Required for model GAST in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

gastExhaustTimeS.description: GAST exhaust temperature time constant T3 (s). Required for model GAST in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

gastAmbientLimitPu.description: GAST ambient temperature load limit AT (pu on the machine base): the turbine power the exhaust temperature limit settles at; the initial mechanical power must not exceed it. Required for model GAST in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

gastTemperatureGain.description: GAST temperature limiter gain KT (0 or above). Required for model GAST in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.
